items.followUp: How does a bond pair differ from a lone pair of electrons?

rubric.why: A bond pair is shared by two atoms.
rubric.description: A bond pair consists of electrons shared between two atoms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the pair is shared between two atoms.

rubric.why: A lone pair is not used to form a bond.
rubric.description: A lone pair consists of electrons that are not shared in a bond.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the pair is not shared in a bond.

modelAnswer: A bond pair is a pair of electrons shared between two atoms to form a covalent bond.
A lone pair is a pair of valence electrons that is not shared in a bond.

items.followUp: How many electrons are involved in the duet rule and the octet rule?

rubric.why: The duet rule refers to a stable outermost shell containing two electrons.
rubric.description: The duet rule states that an atom tends to attain two electrons in its outermost shell.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the duet rule involves two electrons in the outermost shell.

rubric.why: The octet rule refers to a stable outermost shell containing eight electrons.
rubric.description: The octet rule states that an atom tends to attain eight electrons in its outermost shell.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the octet rule involves eight electrons in the outermost shell.

modelAnswer: According to the duet rule, an atom tends to attain two electrons in its outermost shell.
According to the octet rule, an atom tends to attain eight electrons in its outermost shell.

items.followUp: What is meant by an unsaturated solution?

rubric.why: A saturated solution has dissolved as much solute as it can under the stated conditions.
rubric.description: It cannot dissolve any more solute.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that no more solute can dissolve.

rubric.why: The amount of solute that can dissolve depends on temperature.
rubric.description: The definition applies at a given temperature.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including the temperature condition.

modelAnswer: A saturated solution is one that cannot dissolve any more solute at a given temperature.
